node.title: Node info
node.identityBody.confirmed: The last chain check matched the selected profile. Spending is checked again by the server.
node.identityBody.waiting: The chain check has not finished. Spending is blocked until it passes.
node.identityBody.refused: The chain check failed. Spending is blocked until it passes.
node.connectionsHelp: Use an announced peer address to connect another Lightning node. These are peer addresses, not management credentials.
node.noAddressesHelp: This node has not announced a peer address. Configure an announcement on the node to share a connection URI.
node.capabilitiesHelp: Capabilities allowed by the stored credential scopes. They do not guarantee that an operation is currently available.
node.credentialFreshness: View access is checked when this panel loads. Spend status comes from the last credential verification; this page does not test spending.
node.stale: Refresh failed. Previously loaded data is shown; it may be out of date.
errors.capability_missing: This credential cannot show this information. Ask the node administrator to enable the required view methods.
